name: dialog
summary: A centered panel over the page that asks for the person's attention for a task, and becomes a bottom sheet on a phone.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Names the panel for assistive technology and shows at its top. Always required; hideTitle hides it visually.

properties.name: hideTitle
properties.description: Hides the title visually; it still names the panel.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A short line under the title, read out when the panel opens.

properties.name: closeLabel
properties.description: The close button's label and spoken name.

properties.name: closeOnOutsidePress
properties.description: Whether a press outside the panel, on its backdrop, closes it. Escape and the close button always close it.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: auto centers the panel from 640 points up and slides it from the bottom below; dialog and sheet force one form.

slots.name: content
slots.description: The body; it scrolls when taller than the screen.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The actions row, primary action last.

events.name: close
events.description: The panel closed: by Escape, the close button or an outside press, with the reason.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The close button and each footer action scale to the press scale, never under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Its title.
accessibility.keyboard: Focus moves in when it opens and stays inside; Escape closes it; focus returns to what opened it.
accessibility.web: A role="dialog" with aria-modal, named by its title and described by its description.
accessibility.apple: A presented sheet or panel named by its title, with the close button reachable.
accessibility.windows: A ContentDialog: UI Automation ControlType.Window named by the title, with a Close button.
accessibility.android: A Compose Dialog: a node with a pane title from the title, a heading for it, and a Close button with the dismiss action.

cases.person: A centered panel with the title, the line under it, a close button in the top corner and a Save action at the foot.
A panel with no visible title.

deviations: size also takes 2xl, which a phone has no use for.
presentation auto never shows a bottom sheet: Windows has no phone form, so auto is the centered dialog.
presentation auto is a bottom sheet on a compact width and a centered dialog from 640dp.
